item.description: The HttpSrv class is missing initialization of several attributes that are accessed by HttpCli. Specifically, the attributes ptn_cc, ptn_hsafe, and uparam_cc_ok are referenced in HttpCli.run() but are only initialized in the HttpSrv constructor.
item.contract: Add initialization of ptn_cc, ptn_hsafe, and uparam_cc_ok attributes in HttpSrv.__init__ method to ensure they are available when accessed by HttpCli.
